units.source_text: 早晨团体客人走后，她们把餐盘里剩下的生鸡蛋藏在客房的壁橱里。

en.t: In the morning, after the group guests had left, they hid the raw eggs left on the plates in the guest room closet.

units.source_text: 然后，趁打扫走廊的时候，用客房的铁壶煮熟。

en.t: Then, while they were cleaning the hallway, they boiled them in the iron kettle from the guest room.
